name: Hallowed Memorandum

angles.text: Gnomes approaching the Light bring sharp intellect and curiosity to spiritual study, treating holy mysteries as puzzles to ponder alongside faith.
This memorandum marks the start of formal priestly instruction in Coldridge Valley, introducing nascent healers to the philosophy of the Holy Light.

faq.answer: The memorandum was passed along by a local ally while you were assisting around Coldridge Valley, having originated from Branstock Khalder, the priest trainer residing inside Anvilmar.

Branstock Khalder is a dwarven priest trainer stationed inside Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. He mentors fledgling priests in understanding the Light and harnessing holy forces to mend wounds or smite evil.

aliases: how do gnomes view the light
faq.answer: Branstock explains that gnomish curiosity and intellect serve as natural avenues for understanding the Light. Rather than treating it as a strict technical craft, he encourages viewing it as a philosophical riddle that unites thought and feeling.
faq.q: How do gnomes approach the Holy Light?

aliases: what is the light according to branstock
faq.answer: Branstock describes the Light not as an exacting technical discipline, but as a riddle that offers practical blessings and life lessons, discovered by uniting one's thoughts and inner emotions.
faq.q: What does Branstock teach about the Light?

faq.answer: Once a priest begins to comprehend the Light, Branstock offers guidance on channeling that power directly into protective healing prayers and holy smiting against the wicked, in exchange for modest donations.
faq.q: What abilities does Branstock offer to teach?

faq.answer: Anvilmar is the central fortress and welcoming hall located in the heart of Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh, housing trainers and refuge for dwarves and visiting gnomes.
faq.q: Where can Branstock Khalder be found?

sections.body: While assisting allies in Coldridge Valley, promising gnomish novitiates receive the Hallowed Memorandum, an introductory message directing them to seek out Branstock Khalder inside Anvilmar. Serving as a call to spiritual study, the note invites aspiring priests to begin their formal tutelage in Dun Morogh.
sections.title: A Summons to Anvilmar

sections.body: Upon presenting the memorandum, Branstock Khalder welcomes the novice into the fold. He explains that delving into the Holy Light is not a rigid technical craft, but a profound riddle requiring curiosity, keen intelligence, and harmony between intellect and emotion. Through contemplation and practice, students learn to channel these holy mysteries into restorative mending and divine retribution.
sections.title: Puzzles of the Faith

summary: The Hallowed Memorandum is a written summons directing fledgling gnome priests in Coldridge Valley to meet with Branstock Khalder inside Anvilmar. It marks the commencement of their spiritual training, framing the Holy Light as a philosophical riddle well-suited to gnomish intellect and curiosity.
